''See also: [[Darius Allbright Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Darius Allbright is a [[Knight-Adjunct]] and Captain of the [[Knights of the White Sun]] within the [[Luminian Order]]. He is the grandson of [[Jameson Allbright]], the distinguished Head of the [[Order]]. Once considered a candidate to become the first knight-raised Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head in three centuries, his path to leadership was altered by a traumatic encounter with the entity Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut. This battle resulted in the loss of his face, leaving a featureless black void or Shadow{{!}}shadow where his countenance should be. He often conceals this void beneath a hood, though he has been known to reveal it, sometimes using humor to deflect from the nature of his injury. Darius is a skilled combatant who utilizes an invested blade that can emit intense, star-like light to fight against darkness. Despite his physical transformation, he remains a dedicated member of the [[Order]], assisting in tasks such as coordinating city evacuations. His history with the [[Elders]] is deeply personal; he has faced Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut directly and has been subject to its influence, even experiencing moments where the entity spoke to him or attempted to use his body.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Darius is a man without a face, possessing a black circle of nothingness or a flat plane of darkness where his features should be. He wears blackened or charred silvery armor and carries a gleaming [[sword]]. A spawn of Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut is wrapped around his hooded face.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Darius supports a peace deal between the [[Guilds]] and assists the [[Luminian Order]] with coordinating city evacuations. He acts as an ally to a female character he is not well-acquainted with.}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Darius Allbright serves as a Captain of the [[Knights of the White Sun]] and a [[Knight-Adjunct]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref> The grandson of [[Jameson Allbright]], he carries a [[sword]] and utilizes an [[Awakened pen]] that leaves permanent ink upon his skin.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" /> Described as a man without a face, his countenance is a flat plane of darkness or a black Elder void where features should be.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 11</ref> He is considered Elder-touched due to an Elder-shadowed condition caused by a run-in with [[Elderspawn]], which was part of an [[Elder curse]] that Mekendi Maxeus{{!}}Maxeus attempted to banish years ago.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> While he has been seen wearing silvery armor and a gleaming [[sword]], his armor is also described as blackened or charred.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Luminian Order evacuation}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|During the evacuation of the city, Darius Allbright assisted in coordinating the efforts for the [[Luminian Order]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref> As he heard the whispers of the void and felt the approaching cold [[wind]] of [[Urg’naut]], a spawn of the entity became wrapped around his face.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> Darius serves as the host for Urg’naut{{!}}Urg'naut, a state in which his body is utilized by a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> During these events, [[Shera]] was positioned only an inch from his chest.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Darius Allbright]] has a spawn of [[Urg’naut]] wrapped around his face.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>

* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Excuse my haste, Knight-Adjunct, but your grandfather wishes to see you immediately.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I had a run-in with some Elderspawn a few years back. As I was so handsome, one of them borrowed my face, and he has yet to give it back.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“I’ve watched my grandfather struggle under the title of Guild Head all my life.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}
